sql.company.getAll: select id, company_name from flow.company order by parent_company_id nulls first, company_name;
sql.company.getById: select id, company_name from flow.company where id = :id;
sql.company.getCompaniesAssignedToUser: select c.id, c.company_name from flow.company c inner join flow.user_company uc on uc.company_id = c.id where uc.user_id = :userId and uc.archived is not true
sql.company.getCompaniesAvailableForUser: select c.id, c.company_name from flow.company c inner join flow.user_company uc on uc.company_id = c.id where uc.user_id = :userId and uc.archived is not true;
sql.company.updateCompany: update flow.company set company_name = :companyName, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
